This '''capital city''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Banks's squadron|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] went on a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] to disable a supposed [[Oznek power plant|droid command center]] located inside this [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TEW" />
